details.description:
Selsun Anti-Dandruff Shampoo is a dual-action formula that effectively treats and controls dandruff, provides relief from itching and flaking and helps prevent the reappearance of dandruff is available with improved fragrance. Originating from the house of Abbott, Selsun is one of the most trusted and effective anti-dandruff shampoos.
Selsun shampoo has been available for over 90 years. It is a topical medicated anti-dandruff shampoo with selenium sulphide (2.5%), which helps treat and control dandruff through its unique dual-action benefit. It targets the root cause of dandruff i.e. the fungi that cause dandruff, clears the build-up of dead skin cells, relieving flaking and itching caused by dandruff. Selsun is an ideal anti-dandruff shampoo for women and men and comes with an improved fragrance.
For best result, use Abbott Selsun Shampoo twice weekly for two weeks and then only when necessary or as directed by the physician. In case of any discomfort after using the product or worsening the condition, seek medical attention immediately. There is no data to support the use of selenium sulphide by pregnant or breastfeeding women. For details, please consult with your physician. Selsun must not be applied to infected or broken skin. Keep away from children. Avoid usage if you are allergic to any of the ingredients mentioned on the product packaging. Read the label instruction carefully before use.
details.ingredients: Purified Water, Cocamidopropyl Betaine, Sodium Methyl Cocoy Taurate, Caprylyl/Capryl Glucoside, Glycerin, Polysorbate 80. Ethylene Glycol Monostearate, Selenium Disulphide 1% W/W, Dimethicone & Cocamidopropyl Betaine & C12-15 Pareth-3 & Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride, Carbomer, PEG 150 Distearate, Citric Acid Monohydrate, Disodium Edetate, Perfume, Polyquaternium-10, Calcium Aluminium Borosilicate & Silica & Titanium Dioxide, Colour Sunset Yellow FCF C. I 15985 & Phenoxy Ethanol.
details.usageInstructions:
Massage after applying Selsun daily on wet hair.
Allow it to remain for 3-4 minutes.
Rinse your hair thoroughly and use it daily for better results. 
Use twice weekly for two weeks and then only when necessary or as directed by the physician.
